name: Lawful Good
description: Acts as a good person should, in line with what society expects of them — gold dragons, paladins, most dwarves.

name: Neutral Good
description: Does the best good they can within the rules, but is unconcerned with order for its own sake — many celestials, some Cleric and Druid characters.

name: Chaotic Good
description: Acts as their conscience directs, with little regard for what others expect — copper dragons, unicorns, rebellious heroes.

name: Lawful Neutral
description: Acts in accordance with law, tradition, or personal codes — judges, soldiers following orders, monks of devoted orders.

name: Neutral
description: Acts naturally without prejudice or compulsion. Druids, most animals, and pragmatic merchants often fall here.

name: Chaotic Neutral
description: Follows their whims, holding their personal freedom above all else — many adventurers, wandering rogues, free spirits.

name: Lawful Evil
description: Methodically takes what they want within the limits of a code of tradition or order — devils, blue dragons, oppressive nobility.

name: Neutral Evil
description: Does whatever they can get away with, without compassion or qualms — assassins, murderous mercenaries, hags.

name: Chaotic Evil
description: Acts with arbitrary violence, spurred by greed, hatred, or bloodlust — demons, red dragons, savage marauders.

name: Unaligned
description: Used for creatures incapable of moral or ethical action — most beasts, oozes, and constructs that don't have intelligence sufficient for moral choices.
